title: `use_static_cpp=no` cannot be used together with d3d12 driver
body:
### Tested versions

Latest master

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

Trying to build with dynamically linked standard library and override `malloc`.

`scons dev_mode=yes dev_build=yes module_mono_enabled=yes scu_build=yes use_static_cpp=no` fails with
```
[100%] libNIR.windows.x86_64.lib(glsl_types.windows.x86_64.obj) : error LNK2038: 检测到“RuntimeLibrary”的不匹配项: 值“MT_StaticRelease”不匹配值“MD_DynamicRelease”(os_windows.windows.editor.dev.x86_64.obj 中)
libNIR.windows.x86_64.lib(u_qsort.windows.x86_64.obj) : error LNK2038: 检测到“RuntimeLibrary”的不匹配项: 值“MT_StaticRelease”不匹
配值“MD_DynamicRelease”(os_windows.windows.editor.dev.x86_64.obj 中)
  正在创建库 bin\godot.windows.editor.dev.x86_64.mono.lib 和对象 bin\godot.windows.editor.dev.x86_64.mono.exp
MSVCRT.lib(initializers.obj) : warning LNK4098: 默认库“libcmt.lib”与其他库的使用冲突；请使用 /NODEFAULTLIB:library
LINK : error LNK1218: 警告被视为错误；未生成输出文件
scons: *** [bin\godot.windows.editor.dev.x86_64.mono.exe] Error 4098
```

While `scons dev_mode=yes dev_build=yes module_mono_enabled=yes scu_build=yes use_static_cpp=no d3d12=no` compiles successfully.

The reason is probably that `libNIR` is a precompiled binary, so we cannot specify `/MD` for it.

### Steps to reproduce

Build on windows with `scons dev_mode=yes dev_build=yes module_mono_enabled=yes scu_build=yes use_static_cpp=no`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

No need
